violations.text: Chicken was observed held at 86 degrees Fahrenheit. Beef observed with temperature 0f 127 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot hold unit observed to be off. Unit was turned on to hold proper temperatures. Foods out of temperature were reheated above 165 degrees F and returned to hot hold unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. One full-time employee must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. Establishment does have employees certified in an approved food safety management course. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2025
